source-4c7d812a644ad96e161da084.passage: Registered 2026-07-30. Section 2 commencement: day after final parliamentary disallowance day; no calendar date specified in the instrument. Schedule 25 inserts s25.2 requiring fare systems to comply with selected AS EN 301 549:2020 clauses, including hardware section 8 and software section 11 for public use. Schedule 34 s35.22 applies those changes to new conveyances/premises/infrastructure and fare-system elements installed from commencement. Other Part 35 provisions distinguish existing assets. This check does not establish the actual commencement date.
